title: The Pocket Post
description: The first Pocket Post from Juniper Vale's kiln studio in Port Halcyon, as a phone you can play.

sections.title: Hello from the kiln
sections.label: Hello
sections.html:
The kiln is warm again. This month the studio moved two doors down, onto the corner with the good light.

Here is everything new, in six short screens. Read them all and Snake is yours.

sections.title: Three things I tried
sections.label: Tried
sections.html:
1. Glazing on Sundays only. Fewer cracks, calmer weeks.
  2. One class a month, eight seats. It filled in a day.
  3. Writing this letter by voice note. You are reading the result.

sections.title: The piece of the month
sections.label: Piece
sections.html:
A speckled cream mug with a thumb rest, made in a batch of twelve.

Every one is a little different. That is the point.

sections.title: On my desk
sections.label: Desk
sections.html:
• A notebook of glaze recipes, half of them failures
  • A postcard from a student in Wren Harbour
  • A list titled things I will not do this winter

sections.title: Dates for your diary
sections.label: Dates
sections.html:
Sat 7 Nov. Open studio, 10 till 4.

Sat 21 Nov. Wheel class, eight seats.

Sun 13 Dec. The winter shelf sale.

sections.title: One last thing
sections.label: Last
sections.html:
If this landed for you, press 8 and pass it to one friend who would love a slower inbox.

See you next month.
Juniper
